verdict.rationale: Elicit's own docs cover live collaboration in shared Research Agent sessions, where edit-access collaborators can query the agent, create artifacts and edit existing ones. They also cover view-only links that work for people without an account, shared items arriving in Recents, and sharing Collections with colleagues. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the sharing features, and explicit documentation that standalone Research Reports can be link-shared rather than only exported as PDF/Word.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can share a research session or report with collaborators who can view or build on it

citations.quote: Invite your team members to collaborate live with you in Research Agent sessions. Collaborators with edit access can ask the agent questions in your session, produce new artifacts (documents, tables, etc.), and edit other artifacts
Toggle on "Anyone with the link can view", then click "Copy link". This works for people without an Elicit account
Recents is also where anything shared with you arrives.
